text:
Alex (Partnerships): Kickoff: marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need to align on three quick things before we hand off: listing asset checklist, billing SKU mapping, and compliance blurbs for EU. Who volunteers?

Rina (Product): I can own listing asset checklist + copy. We need icons (512x512 PNG), short/long descriptions, screenshots, and a link to docs. Also confirm allowed claims; some marketplaces reject "best"/"enterprise" without evidence.

Kai (Infra): I'll own billing SKU mapping and technical artifacts. For each cloud we'll produce a mapping file: canonical_sku -> {aws_sku,gcp_sku,azure_offer}. Example in plain text: canonical=redwood-core-pro | aws=redwood-core-pro-v1 | gcp=redwood-core-pro | azure=redwood-core-pro-0001. Also we need a health check endpoint (GET /_mp/health) that returns 200 and accepts X-Marketplace-Token header.

Sam (Legal): Compliance: provide DPA link, contact for DSARs, export control statement. For EU we should note data residency for telemetry and billing metadata. I'll prepare a short blurb to paste into listings and the legal artifact zip.

Tariq (Marketing): I'll sanitize the copy and produce 512/128 icons. One ask: marketplaces often strip HTML, so keep the long description plain text with line breaks and bullet-like lines. Also provide a one-line tagline <= 80 chars.

Alex (Partnerships): Sounds good. Two blocking questions: (1) trial SKU handling (boxed vs metered) and (2) if we need a reseller agreement for Azure. Sam?

Sam (Legal): Recommend boxed trial for launch (simpler). Azure reseller path adds extra docs (publisher agreement); we should avoid reseller for initial listing. We'll include a short reseller decl that we are direct publisher.

marketplace-bot: New runbook created: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/runbooks/onboarding-1714009876. Checklist items: icons, copy, sku-mapping, health-endpoint, legal-zip, publisher-declaration.

Rina (Product): I'll draft the copy and attach to the ticket. Kai, please confirm the SKU max length constraints you found in earlier runs so we can pick canonical rules.

Kai (Infra): Quick SKU constraints: use lowercase alnum + dash, max 64 chars. Azure offer name can be longer but keep canonical conservative. I'll create the mapping CSV and push to repo under infra/marketplace/mappings/1714009876.csv.

Tariq (Marketing): ETA for icons and sanitized copy: Tue EOD.

Sam (Legal): ETA for legal artifact bundle: Tue EOD.

Alex (Partnerships): OK lets reconvene Wed 10am PST to sign off and kick the publisher portal upload. I'll create the invite and the ticket. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
